Title: Rishabh's Day

Cast

1. Rishabh - 10 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Neeta - 39 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Rishabh stands in the courtyard. Neeta stands near him.]

Neeta: "Rishabh, what's the plan today?"

[Rishabh points at the sky.]

Rishabh (excited): "What happened?"

[Rishabh smiles at Mother.]

Rishabh: "What next?"

[Rishabh gets frightened and steps back.]

Rishabh: "That's great!"

[Rishabh trips on the step and scrapes his knee; it bleeds.]

Rishabh: "I knew it!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Rishabh is sitting on a chair in the living room. Neeta stands near him.]

Rishabh: "What a nice place."

[Rishabh stands up.]

Rishabh (softly): "Okay, Mom."

Scene 3: The road - Day

[Rishabh stands by the road. Neeta stands near him.]

Neeta: "Look over here."

[Rishabh rides his bicycle down the road.]

Rishabh: "One more time!"

[Rishabh gets into the car.]

Rishabh (excited): "Okay, Mom."

[Rishabh gets on the bus.]

Rishabh (excited): "I knew it!"

[Rishabh gets off the school bus.]

Rishabh (happily): "And then?"

[Rishabh hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Rishabh: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
